name: Touch
description: Prefabricated pointer behavior mixed into objects that extend Touch.
access: An object that extends Touch receives this.touch. Call the methods on this.touch. Enable and disable touch from the object's own enable and disable methods. This is not an OML node.

methods.name: touch.enable
methods.description: Enable touch behavior on this object.

methods.name: touch.disable
methods.description: Disable touch behavior on this object.

methods.name: touch.add
methods.description: Create a touch behavior and keep it on the touch list.

params.name: config
params.description: Behavior configuration. Set id if you want to retrieve it later.

methods.name: touch.get
methods.description: Return a touch behavior by the id passed to touch.add.

params.name: touch
params.description: The behavior instance or its id.

events.name: touch.down
events.description: Pointer down. Prefer this over touchstart or mousedown.

events.name: touch.up
events.description: Pointer up. Prefer this over touchend or mouseup.

events.name: touch.move
events.description: Pointer move. Prefer this over touchmove or mousemove.
